rows.next_step: Synthesize existing architectural literature regarding meta-reasoning and error-correction capabilities.
rows.question: How do major cognitive architectures address model self-correction or error detection in their internal reasoning processes?
rows.reason: Existing evidence highlights major cognitive architectures (ACT-R, Soar) as consensus models; this project evaluates their capacity for self-monitoring and error detection.
rows.title: Self-Correction in Cognitive Architectures
